fairness_rules: Advance silhouettes and directional cues before the commitment; no blind lethal pit.

depth_contract: Background equipment is attached to visible wall brackets, ceiling rails, pipes or architecture. Show the pivot and full trajectory into the riding plane.
Separate background silhouette, projected target cue, moving attack body, contact-plane collision, broken support rim and below-channel waterfall layers.
Shadow and cue communicate the eventual danger footprint; they cause no damage. Only declared contact phases collide, using both hero heads and full90x28 board support.
Water remains safe where the channel still supports it. A broken channel shows missing structure, a dark drop, fractured edges and continuous falling water, not an unexplained dark water patch.
Destruction persists in world coordinates until the entire hole and visual rim clear the course; no timed healing under a rider. Pause/reset/checkpoint must synchronize geometry, effects and audio.

encounter_composition: Reserve a reachable opposite-bank refuge and its approach/exit. Never combine a head commitment with a hand strike or another obstacle closing that refuge. Reserve the refuge until the entire hole passes, not merely until the head retreats.
Do not attack through an existing jump, island landing or ramp commitment unless a separate full-sequence proof establishes a safe response. Do not invalidate a previously signaled safe landing.

Recurring sightings teach anticipation, lane lock and track damage separately. The final fight combines learned attacks with deliberately reserved recovery windows; isolated showcase three-second rests remain unchanged.
Proposed final encounter is a scrolling chase arena at560 with a curated supply of intact track and fixtures. A fixed arena or speed change is an alternative requiring approval, not assumed.

defeat_options.proposal: Lure a committed bite into a clearly signaled heavy fixture or valve assembly. Recovery exposes a vulnerability or advances environmental defeat.
defeat_options.tradeoff: Fits the existing steering/jump ride without enabling weapons; requires fixtures, hit feedback and a clear reason the fixture hurts or jams the mouth.

defeat_options.proposal: After a missed bite, a visible mouth weak point can be attacked briefly.
defeat_options.tradeoff: Ride currently disables firing; enabling combat, hero weapon parity, boss HP and targeting would need explicit design and implementation approval.

defeat_options.proposal: Survive a finite chase and steer the boss into a prepared environmental trap.
defeat_options.tradeoff: No new shooting loop, but player agency must be clear so victory is more than a hidden timer.
